# NICE (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence)

> NICE develops evidence-based guidance, quality standards, and health technology assessments to improve patient care across the NHS and social care sectors in England.

NICE is the authoritative source for clinical guidance, health technology evaluation, and quality standards in the UK healthcare system. The organization works with NHS England, healthcare professionals, patients, and life sciences companies to ensure best practices and innovation reach patients efficiently.

## Key Topics

- NICE guidance
- Quality standards
- Health technology assessment
- Evidence-based recommendations
- Implementation guidance
- Digital health
- Social care
- Patient decision aids
- NHS 10 Year Health Plan
- Clinical Knowledge Summaries
- British National Formulary
- Health innovation
- WCAG accessibility
- Stakeholder engagement
- Healthcare quality indicators

## Core Guidance & Standards

- [NICE guidance](https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance): Overview of NICE guidance library covering health, public health, and social care recommendations.
- [Standards and indicators](https://www.nice.org.uk/standards-and-indicators): Library of 200+ quality standards and indicators for measuring healthcare quality and outcomes.
- [What NICE does](https://www.nice.org.uk/what-nice-does): Overview of NICE's guidance development, HTA, quality standards, and health technology assessment.

## Implementation & Practice

- [Implementing NICE guidance](https://www.nice.org.uk/implementing-nice-guidance): Resources and toolkits for healthcare professionals to implement NICE guidance effectively.
- [Implementing NICE guidance](https://www.nice.org.uk/about/what-we-do/into-practice): Resources and toolkits for healthcare professionals to implement NICE guidance in practice.
- [Library and knowledge services](https://www.nice.org.uk/library-and-knowledge-services): Access to journals, databases, and evidence resources via NHS OpenAthens and Cochrane.

## Specialized Guidance Areas

- [Life sciences: how to get your product to market](https://www.nice.org.uk/about/what-we-do/life-sciences): NICE Advice and ILAP pathways for life sciences products to reach healthcare professionals.
- [NICE: backing the healthtech that changes lives](https://www.nice.org.uk/what-nice-does/our-guidance/about-healthtech-guidance/nice-backing-the-healthtech-that-changes-lives): NICE's strengthened role in healthtech guidance aligned with NHS 10 Year Health Plan.
- [Social care](https://www.nice.org.uk/about/nice-communities/social-care): NICE social care guidelines, quality standards, and evidence-based recommendations.

## About NICE & Organization

- [Homepage](https://www.nice.org.uk): NICE homepage introducing organization's mission to deliver best care to patients efficiently.
- [About us](https://www.nice.org.uk/about-us): NICE organizational overview, mission, governance structure, and institutional information.
- [Get involved](https://www.nice.org.uk/get-involved): Stakeholder engagement, committee participation, and public consultation opportunities at NICE.

## Accessibility & Support

- [Accessibility](https://www.nice.org.uk/accessibility): NICE accessibility statement with WCAG compliance, screen reader support, and disability accommodations.

## Featured Stories & Impact

- [NHS 10 year plan: empowering NICE to get better care to people, faster](https://indepth.nice.org.uk/10-year-health-plan-for-the-NHS/index.html): NICE's role in delivering NHS 10 Year Health Plan commitments for innovation and care.
- [From surviving to thriving: Ammaarah's journey with NICE recommended type 1 diabetes technology](https://indepth.nice.org.uk/AmmaarahsJourney/index.html): Patient story showcasing impact of NICE-recommended hybrid closed loop diabetes technology.
